paper_title: Randomized clinical trial to evaluate the effect of fecal microbiota transplant for initial Clostridium difficile infection in intestinal microbiome

pico.outcome: The vancomycin group showed a very different pattern of the microbial composition when comparing to the FMT-FURM group over time.

supplement: pilot study. patients took treatment for the first CDI episode. donor sample(3samples are mixed) is also included. Intervention period and frequency are different between 2 groups. Intervention_period_day is expressed as average values. The exact value is 10~14 days.
